_about: Seasonal event builds for the "Start from a build" panel (separate from the competitive sets in presets.json).
event.on: false hides the whole group once the event is over. For the next event, replace event, raids and sets (give keys their own prefix).
sets work like presets.json sets, plus raids: the raid keys the build is used in. ivs: a stat left out = don't care; 31 = must be 31; 0 = must be 0.
eggMoves: only moves the planner must breed in. verified: true once checked in game.
test/events.test.js checks every set against species.json and every raid key.

event.name: Christmas raids
event.label: Christmas event raids

groups.label: Support and weather
groups.note: The Pokémon that make raids work: Tailwind, Haze, sun, rain, Heal Block and Trick Room.

groups.label: Fire
groups.note: The main damage in most Christmas raids: four Ice bosses, Grass, Steel and Articuno.

groups.label: Fighting and Steel
groups.note: For Glaceon, Stantler, Clefable and the Ice bosses.

groups.label: Ice
groups.note: Salamence (4× weak), Togekiss and Tangrowth after it adapts.

event.when: PokeMMO's Christmas event usually starts on December 24th and runs into early January. In 2024 the 12 raids opened one by one from December 24th to January 1st; in 2025 the same 12 came back with a new 5★ Articuno.
rules: Each raid gives an alpha of the boss and a Wish Tag. All 12 Wish Tags open Jirachi on Birth Island.
Every Pokémon in your party must be from a different evolution line, and no two can hold the same item.
3★ raids need a level 60 Pokémon you caught yourself, 4★ need level 75. Higher-star raids open only after the lower ones.
Cards are sorted by usefulness: support first, then attackers by type, each group starting with the builds used in the most raids (⭐ = five or more).
Raids don't need perfect Pokémon: the builds aim for 3×31 in the stats that matter. More 31s help but cost more.
event.caveat: Built from the 2024 and 2025 events. PokeMMO hasn't announced Christmas 2026 yet, so bosses and phases may change.

raids.name: Glaceon
raids.boss: Ice Body. Moves: Blizzard, Shadow Ball, Water Pulse, Ice Beam.
raids.plan: Switch a Drought Ninetales in on turn 1 to replace the snow with sun. Clear Reflect with Brick Break, then Fighting attacks from 50%.

raids.name: Raichu
raids.boss: Lightning Rod, Expert Belt. Moves: Thunderbolt, Signal Beam, Grass Knot, Discharge.
raids.phases: 100% shields its helpers (they can't be knocked out) · 75% Magnet Rise · 50% Reflect · 20% Agility
raids.plan: Tailwind lead and Ground attacks. Gravity (Sableye) undoes Magnet Rise, Defog or Brick Break clears Reflect, Haze undoes Agility.

raids.name: Stantler
raids.phases: 100% Reflect · 75% Roar · 50% swaps physical and special · 30% Confuse Ray
raids.plan: Defog or Brick Break the Reflect on turn 1, then Fighting attacks every turn.

raids.name: Chimecho
raids.phases: 100% raises every stat · 75% Wish · 50% Cosmic Power · 33% Trick Room
raids.plan: Haze the boosts on turn 1 and again after Cosmic Power, Dark attacks, Heal Block around Wish, and your own Trick Room (or slow Sucker Punch users) for the end.

raids.name: Sawsbuck
raids.weak: Fire, Fighting, Flying, Ice, Poison, Bug
raids.boss: Chlorophyll, Sitrus Berry. Moves: Horn Leech, Wild Charge, Low Kick, Body Slam.
raids.phases: 100% Swords Dance · 65% Agility · 50% Swords Dance · 20% flurry of attacks
raids.plan: Two Tailwinds and a Haze kept for after Agility. Incinerate burns its berry. Fire attacks, don't hit its helpers (they can bring snow), bring nothing weak to Grass.

raids.name: Beartic
raids.phases: 100% snow · 65% Roar · 40% raises every stat · 25% snow again
raids.plan: Ninetales switched in on turn 1 for sun, a spare Ninetales for the second snow, a Murkrow to Haze the boosts.

raids.name: Clefable
raids.boss: Substitute, Belly Drum and Rest at the start.
raids.plan: Just Fighting attacks every turn. No Haze, no screens.

raids.name: Tangrowth
raids.boss: Moves: Ancient Power, Brick Break, Solar Beam, Earthquake. Opens after all the 3★ Christmas raids.
raids.plan: Tailwind, then Fire under its own sun. Heal Block for Ingrain. Once Adaptation resists Fire, switch to Bug and Ice (Volcarona, Jynx). Reset if a Cherrim helper shows up and you can't handle it.

raids.name: Vanilluxe
raids.phases: 100% Light Screen · 65% Acid Armor · 50% Autotomize · 25% type chart flips
raids.plan: Lead Defog, Tailwind and Ninetales for sun, Fire attackers in the first five slots, a spare Tailwind and a Haze after 40%, Ice attacks last (the flipped chart makes Ice hit Ice hard).

raids.name: Togekiss
raids.boss: Starf Berry. Moves: Flamethrower, Air Slash, Water Pulse, Tri Attack.
raids.phases: 100% Rainbow (double side effects) · 75% permanent Tailwind · 50% Wish · 25% Nasty Plot
raids.plan: Turn 1: one Tailwind and three Skill Link Cloyster. Turn 2: set rain (Drizzle Politoed), then Thunder from everyone. Heal Block the Wish, refresh Tailwind.

raids.name: Gardevoir
raids.boss: Synchronize, Expert Belt. Moves: Aura Sphere, Psyshock, Shadow Ball, Grass Knot.
raids.phases: 100% shield (attack types must alternate) · 80% Reflect · 60% Trick Room · 30% Trick Room again
raids.plan: Fast Dark and Ghost attackers before Trick Room (Krookodile, Hydreigon, Chandelure, Volcarona), slow ones under it (Tyranitar, Honchkrow, Scizor). Agree who attacks with which type; put Speed in nicknames.

raids.name: Salamence
raids.boss: Moves: Dragon Claw, Earthquake, Fire Fang.
raids.phases: 100% Roar · 66% Wish · 50% permanent Taunt · 20% permanent Tailwind
raids.plan: Lead a Magic Bounce Xatu with Tailwind (bounces Roar). Ice attacks, Heal Block on Wish, a Mental Herb Murkrow for a second Tailwind through Taunt.

raids.name: Jirachi
raids.boss: Final raid on Birth Island, opened by the 12 Wish Tags (Wishing Star). Serene Grace, Room Service. Moves: Drain Punch, Hidden Power, Psychic, Iron Head. A 5★ version exists.
raids.phases: 100% Doom Desire · 75% Doom Desire · 50% shield (lower its defences or raise your attack) · 25% Trick Room
raids.plan: All Fire: Typhlosion Eruption and Specs Drought Vulpix Overheat on turn 1, Prankster Tailwind, Fake Tears to break the shield, Reckless Emboar, then slow Fire (Emboar, Torkoal) under its Trick Room.

raids.name: Articuno
raids.boss: New in 2025, Seafoam Islands last floor. Snow Cloak, Leftovers. Moves: Hidden Power Ground, Weather Ball, Blizzard, Hurricane. Win for a chance at an Alpha Articuno.
raids.phases: 100% snow + strong winds · 80% permanent snow · 60% shield · 40% Tailwind · 20% Roost
raids.plan: Rock and Fire: Choice Band Tyranitar Stone Edge, Archeops and Rampardos Head Smash, Charizard and Typhlosion Blast Burn, Darmanitan Flare Blitz, Chandelure Overheat. Support: Prankster Sableye (Trick a Toxic Orb, Gravity), Murkrow Tailwind, Whimsicott Fake Tears, Bronzong Trick Room.

sets.name: Prankster Haze + Tailwind
sets.notes: The most used support in the 2024 guides. Mental Herb lets it Tailwind once through Salamence's Taunt. Tailwind is a TM (it drops from Santa's Presents).

sets.name: Prankster Tailwind + Fake Tears
sets.notes: Fake Tears breaks Jirachi's shield and helps special attackers everywhere. Encore was turned off against raid bosses for a while in 2024, so Fake Tears is the one that matters.

sets.name: Drought sun
sets.notes: Switch it in on turn 1 so its sun replaces the boss's snow. A second player bringing one covers the boss's second snow.

sets.name: Trick Room + Heal Block
sets.notes: 0 Speed makes your own Trick Room as strong as it can be. Genderless, so it only breeds with Ditto. If you have no 0 Speed parent, untick the 0 and keep Sassy.

sets.name: Choice Scarf Heal Block
sets.notes: Fast Heal Block stops Ingrain and Wish. Smeargle can do the same job.

sets.name: Prankster Gravity + Trick
sets.notes: Gravity grounds Raichu after Magnet Rise. Trick gives the boss the Toxic Orb (Articuno plan).

sets.name: Choice Specs Drought
sets.notes: Jirachi plan: leave it unevolved (an Everstone stops it evolving). It sets sun and fires one Overheat; guides say Ninetales is too bulky for this slot.

sets.name: Magic Bounce Tailwind
sets.notes: Magic Bounce sends Salamence's opening Roar back, so the lead stays in.

sets.name: Drizzle rain
sets.notes: Rain makes Thunder never miss. Captivate works on raid bosses whatever their gender (2024 change).

sets.name: Life Orb Eruption
sets.notes: Eruption is strongest at full HP, so it goes first. One of the Fire picks in almost every Christmas raid.

sets.name: Choice Specs Overheat
sets.notes: Infiltrator hits through Light Screen and Reflect. Fast Ghost for Gardevoir before Trick Room.

sets.name: Choice Specs Blast Burn
sets.notes: Solar Power (hidden ability) adds even more damage under a teammate's sun. Blaze is fine if you have it already.

sets.name: Sheer Force Flare Blitz
sets.notes: Darumaka hatches with Hustle; Darmanitan's first ability is Sheer Force, so hatch the first-slot ability and evolve.

sets.name: Bug Buzz + Fire
sets.notes: Covers Tangrowth both before and after Adaptation, and Gardevoir with Bug Buzz.

sets.name: Reckless Flare Blitz
sets.notes: Jirachi turn 2 hitter, and slow enough to move first under Jirachi's Trick Room. Reckless is its hidden ability.

sets.name: Guts Mach Punch
sets.notes: Fighting spam for Glaceon, Stantler and Clefable. Drain Punch keeps it alive through Clefable's Belly Drum hits.

sets.name: Close Combat + Bullet Punch
sets.notes: Steel and Fighting both hit the Ice bosses hard. Riolu is a rare Christmas swarm / Mysterious Ball species.

sets.name: Choice Band Stone Edge
sets.notes: Set from the 2025 Articuno guide (Assault Vest also works). Slow Dark attacker under Gardevoir's Trick Room.

sets.name: Head Smash
sets.notes: In the Jirachi plan it sets Tailwind and takes the Iron Head.

sets.name: Choice Scarf Head Smash
sets.notes: Mold Breaker ignores Snow Cloak.

sets.name: Icicle Crash + Earthquake
sets.notes: 4× damage on Salamence, Ground for Raichu once Gravity is up. Swinub line shows up in the Christmas swarms.

sets.name: Ice Beam
sets.notes: Smoochum and Jynx are Christmas swarm species. Smoochum can't breed: evolve it first.

sets.name: Skill Link Icicle Spear
sets.notes: Three of them open the Togekiss raid. Loaded Dice isn't needed with Skill Link.

sets.name: Choice Scarf Earthquake
sets.notes: Fast Dark for Gardevoir before Trick Room, Ground for Raichu.

sets.name: Choice Specs
sets.notes: Dark for Gardevoir and Chimecho, Dragon for Salamence.

sets.name: Sucker Punch (slow)
sets.notes: For the Trick Room part of Gardevoir and Chimecho. Same line as the Murkrow support, so one player can't bring both.

sets.name: Thunder in rain
sets.notes: Thunder never misses in rain. Any fast Thunder user works.
